title: java.lang.RuntimeException: java.lang.NoSuchMethodException: getConfiguration []
body:

Tests run: 0, Failures: 2 ``` I'm guessing they changed the Android O Api and therefore reflection fails in `LocaleUtil`. I'm using version `1.0.3` of the screengrab library. ### Environment
